strategy_roster.name: Support Resist Trade
strategy_roster.notes: Documented long rule: close beyond the previous 55-bar high with the bar opening above EMA(500); the exit is the mirror break of the refreshed band or a loss of the EMA. The initial stop at the opposite band and the 20/40/60-pip staged trailing are pip-based and not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Elliott Wave Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: EWO is SMA(5)-SMA(35) as documented; a local trough that starts rising is rendered as a one-bar ROC of the oscillator crossing above zero, and the opposite turn reverses. The optional StartProtection percentage stop and take-profit have no documented values.

strategy_roster.name: Rectangle Test
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,45) > sma(close,200) and close > ema(close,45) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,10)
strategy_roster.notes: The 10-bar rectangle becomes a Donchian band and the fast EMA(45)/slow SMA(200) direction filter with a close above the fast EMA is used for the long breakout. The 'both averages inside the range' test, the 0.5% rectangle-height cap, the 03:00-22:50 session window, the daily losing-trade cap and the 250/750-point brackets are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Pivot Point SuperTrend TrendFilter
strategy_roster.notes: SuperTrend is not in the DSL, so a trend-filter flip is proxied by a close crossing EMA(20)+3*ATR(10) (MaPeriod 20, Factor 3, AtrPeriod 10) and the flip-down exit by a close below EMA(20). The pivot-based SuperTrend leg and its date-window (seasonality) condition are dropped; docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Bitcoin Exponential Profit
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented 9/21 EMA pair for the entry and exit crosses. Protection is the documented risk percent 1 and reward multiplier 2 (risk x reward); the 0.5% trailing offset and equity-based sizing are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Ketty Channel Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The pre-market channel is rendered as a 20-bar Donchian range (no channel length is documented) and the long is the spike below the channel that arms a stop order on the opposite side, closing when price re-crosses the top. Pre-market/placing hours, the pip buffer and offset parameters and visualise/channel drawing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: The Weekly Factor
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5) <= 0.5 * (donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20)) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,5)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Weekly Factor compression is applied as RangeFilter 0.5 on the 5-bar versus 20-bar range and the session-high break uses the same 5-bar extreme. Session open/close handling and the two-day profitable holding exit need time fields; docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Good Gbbi
strategy_roster.notes: The documented comparison of the recent open with the older open (T1 vs T2, neither valued) is expressed as a positive 5-bar open ROC for the long leg. The TradeTime hour gate, one-trade-per-day limit, Delta point thresholds, pip take-profit/stop-loss and MaxOpenTime are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Black-Scholes Option Pricing
strategy_roster.notes: The module only prices European calls/puts from spot, strike, volatility, rate and expiry; it never places or closes trades, so no market-derived signal exists and the impossible negative-price guard is used. User-set strike/volatility/rate/expiry inputs cannot be expressed in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bronze Pan
strategy_roster.notes: DayImpuls, Williams %R and CCI are unsupported, so the documented long rule (oscillator below DayImpulsLongLevel -50 and rising, %R below WilliamsLevelDown -85, CCI under -CciLevel) becomes a negative-but-rising ROC(14) momentum with RSI(14) oversold. Floating ProfitTarget/LossTarget, the PredBand averaging flip, pip brackets and MinimumBalance gating are not representable.
